decision.note: Tooling-gap cleanup, not a content-quality judgment - same pattern as the earlier lk0x22-0/1 rejections. This proposal reached review-held because tools/lib/artwebsite_seo.py could not resolve an edit location for a meta-description on /contact/: _views_matches() only matched inline render(request,'t.html',{...}) dict literals, while every artwebsite view uses 'context = {...}' passed by name. It therefore has no implementation.new_value, and apply.py refuses any proposal without one, so approving it is a dead end; there is also no supported review-held -> draft transition to re-draft it in place. The resolver bug was fixed 2026-08-06 (24/24 page/action combos now resolve, was 13/24), but the fix does not retroactively make this proposal reviewable. Correct recovery is a fresh proposal from the next full GSC run. Note the underlying signal remains weak on merit (6 impressions, 0 clicks, position 14.17) and may warrant rejection again. Codex advisory review 2026-08-06 concurred.
